snippet.title: Pentu Wonderhunter: Ocean Expedition - Gameplay Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
We made a game!
Enjoy a peak into the gameplay of Pentu Wonderhunter.
With our debut title we’re bringing the charm of classic science books into a modern interactive adventure. Explore hidden underwater worlds and fascinating creatures to life - for curious kids and their parents.
